english: Fall seven times, stand up eight
example_japanese: 彼は失敗しても諦めない。まさに七転び八起きだ。
example_english: He never gives up despite failures. Truly, fall seven times, stand up eight.
explanation: No matter how many times you fall, you can always stand up again. Success comes to those who keep trying.
cultural_note: This proverb embodies the Japanese spirit of *gaman* (endurance) and the belief that resilience is the key to overcoming any obstacle.
